```{r}
# 1. Install the package (only needed once)
install.packages("readxl")

# 2. Load the library
library(readxl)

# 3. Read the Excel file
stud_enrol20_25 <- read_excel("/home/rstudio/EN_2024-2025/5. ElemSec_Enrol_2024-2025_EN.xlsx")
stud_enrol15_20 <- read_excel("/home/rstudio/EN/5. ElemSec_Enrol_2019-2020_EN.xlsx")
teacher_elem_enrol20_25 <- read_excel("/home/rstudio/EN_2024-2025/9a_Teachers_Admin_ECE_Elem_2024-2025_EN.xlsx")
teacher_sec_enrol20_25 <- read_excel("/home/rstudio/EN_2024-2025/9b_Teachers_Admin_Sec_2024-2025_EN.xlsx")
teacher_elem_enrol15_20 <- read_excel("/home/rstudio/EN/9a_Teachers_Admin_ECE_Elem_2019-2020_EN.xlsx")
teacher_sec_enrol15_20 <- read_excel("/home/rstudio/EN/9b_Teachers_Admin_Sec_2019-2020_EN.xlsx")
```

```{r}
head(stud_enrol20_25)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
stud_enrol <- bind_rows(stud_enrol15_20, stud_enrol20_25)
stud_enrol <- stud_enrol[-c(1,2),]
dim(stud_enrol)
head(stud_enrol)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

#make total elementary and secondary enrolment over time plot
ggplot(stud_enrol, aes(x = `Academic Year`, 
                       y = `Total Enrolment - Total Public/Roman Catholic`,
                       group=1)) + 
  geom_point() +               
  geom_line(color = "red") +
  ylim(2000000, 2100000) +
  labs(title="Enrolment in Publically Funded Ontario Schools(Elementary and Secondary)",
       x="Academic Year",
       y="Total Enrolment")
```

```{r}
#make total elementary enrolment over time plot
ggplot(stud_enrol, aes(x = `Academic Year`, 
                       y = `Elementary Enrolment - Total Public/Roman Catholic`,
                       group=1)) + 
  geom_point() +               
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  ylim(1300000, 1450000) +
  labs(title="Enrolment in Publically Funded Elementary Schools in Ontario",
       x="Academic Year",
       y="Total Enrolment")
```

```{r}
#make total elementary enrolment over time plot
ggplot(stud_enrol, aes(x = `Academic Year`, 
                       y = `Secondary Enrolment - Total Public/Roman Catholic`/10000,
                       group=1)) + 
  geom_point() +               
  geom_line(color = "purple") +
  #ylim(620000, 670000) +
  labs(title="Enrolment in Publically Funded Secondary Schools in Ontario",
       x="Academic Year",
       y="Total Enrolment in Ten Thousands") +
  guides(x = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "grey"))
```

```{r}
#make plot for elementary enrolment, public vs catholic
ggplot(stud_enrol, aes(x = `Academic Year`)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = `Elementary Enrolment - Public`,
                color = "Public"), group = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = `Elementary Enrolment - Roman Catholic`,
                color = "Catholic"), group = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = `Elementary Enrolment - Public`,
                 color = "Public")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = `Elementary Enrolment - Roman Catholic`,
                 color = "Catholic")) +
  labs(
    title = "Elementary School Enrolment Over Time",
    x = "Academic Year",
    y = "Total Enrolment",
    color = "School Level") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
  "Public" = "skyblue",
  "Catholic" = "grey"
))
```

```{r}
print(teacher_elem_enrol[2,])
print(stud_enrol$`Academic Year`)
teach_num <- t(teacher_elem_enrol[2,])
colnames(teach_num) <- NULL

teacher_elem_numbers <- data.frame(

  Enrolment = teach_num)
```

```{r}

       x="Academic Year",
       y="Count") +
  theme_bw() +

    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "grey")
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(teacher_sec_numbers, aes(x = `Year`, 
                       y = `Enrolment`,
                       group=1)) + 
  annotate("rect", xmin = 3, xmax = 4,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey90") +
  geom_point() +               
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  ylim(37000, 40000) +
  labs(title="Number of Educators in Ontario Secondary Schools",
       x="Academic Year",
       y="Count") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = seq(37000, 40000, 500),
             colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = seq(0, 10, 1),
             colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x=3.2, y=39000, color="black", label="Early Retirement due to Covid-19", angle=-90) +
  guides(x = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "darkgrey"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "darkgrey")
  )
```
```{r}
teach_split <- read.csv("/home/rstudio/teacher_split.csv")
head(teach_split)
```
```{r}
#make teacher numbers for public and catholic
#missing data points because of administrative overload during covid
ggplot(teach_split, aes(x = `Academic.Year`)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = `Public.Secondary.Educators`,
                color = "Public"), group = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = `Catholic.Secondary.Educators`,
                color = "Catholic"), group = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = `Public.Secondary.Educators`,
                 color = "Public")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = `Catholic.Secondary.Educators`,
                 color = "Catholic")) +
  labs(title="Number of Teachers in Ontario Secondary Schools",
       x="Academic Year",
       y="Count") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
  "Public" = "skyblue",
  "Catholic" = "grey"
))
```
```{r}
#make teacher numbers for public and catholic, normalized
#missing data points because of administrative overload during covid
ggplot(teach_split, aes(x = `Academic.Year`)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = `Public.Secondary.Educators`/29318,
                color = "Public"), group = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = `Catholic.Secondary.Educators`/14912,
                color = "Catholic"), group = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = `Public.Secondary.Educators`/29318,
                 color = "Public")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = `Catholic.Secondary.Educators`/14912,
                 color = "Catholic")) +
  labs(title="Number of Teachers in Ontario Secondary Schools",
       x="Academic Year",
       y="Count") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
  "Public" = "skyblue",
  "Catholic" = "black")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "grey")
  )
```

```{r}
#make student-teacher ratio columns
public_ratio <- stud_enrol$`Secondary Enrolment - Public`/teach_split$Public.Secondary.Educators
catholic_ratio <- stud_enrol$`Secondary Enrolment - Roman Catholic` / teach_split$Catholic.Secondary.Educators
```

```{r}
#make student teach ratios for public and catholic
#missing data points because of administrative overload during covid
ggplot(teach_split, aes(x = `Academic.Year`)) + 
  annotate("rect", xmin = 3, xmax = 6,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "grey90") +
  geom_line(linewidth=1,aes(y = public_ratio,
                color = "Public"), group = 1) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1,aes(y = catholic_ratio,
                color = "Catholic"), group = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = public_ratio,
                 color = "Public")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = catholic_ratio,
                 color = "Catholic")) +
  labs(title="Student-Educator Ratio in Secondary Schools",
       x="Academic Year",
       y="Ratio") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
  "Public" = "skyblue",
  "Catholic" = "darkgrey")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = seq(13.75, 14.75, 0.125),
             colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = seq(0, 10, 1),
             colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x=4.5, y=14.67, color="black", label="*No data due to Covid-19") +
  guides(x = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "lightgrey"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "lightgrey")
  )
```
